_about: Allow-list for tools/pii-scan.mjs (owner decision 111). Only synthetic fixtures, public organisation / help-line contacts and false positives. Secrets: synthetic or false-positive only, never a real key. Never add real personal data. Each entry: path, max hits per type, kind (synthetic | public | false-positive), reason. A forbidden path (.wrangler/, .dev.vars, .env) cannot be listed. Optional "kinds" gives a kind per type when one file holds two kinds.
